capabilities.title: Audit or Edit a SKILL.md Execution Contract
capabilities.description: Resolve one standalone SKILL.md or local plugin source root and audit interpretation drift, workflow clarity, and policy preservation using the shared criteria. Apply requested source edits before final semantic acceptance and native routing/metadata validation according to skill-md-clarifier.

runtimeBinding.instruction: Select $skill-md-clarifier and read its authoritative SKILL.md completely. Resolve only input.target.skillPath or input.target.pluginRoot; do not infer another target. Read the resolved target source and follow the audit or edit route for input.operation. Use the materialized bin/darwin-arm64/skill-md-clarifier-validator exactly where the skill contract assigns deterministic validation; do not substitute cargo run. Inspect input.knownConcerns as declared focus, but do not treat it as a substitute for the complete target audit. For an edit, make only target-scoped, user-requested source changes and preserve unrelated work. Return resultStatus, operation, findings, changes, metadata alignment, enforcement ownership, and validation evidence through the completed output branch. Return the stopped branch with a non-empty stopReason when the target is ambiguous, unavailable, cache-only, or conflicts with higher authority; do not invent a fallback target, enforcement point, or tool result.

authorityRequests.reason: Only when operation is edit, apply user-authorized target-scoped changes to the resolved source-of-truth SKILL.md and directly stale adjacent metadata.
